observed_result: Opportunity cards render `Correspondência com o perfil` whenever both `decision_reason` and `match_reason` are absent.
expected_truth: Missing explanation evidence remains explicitly unavailable/unknown; the UI must not invent a positive match reason.
A score may be displayed only with its own proven semantics; absence of a reason is not evidence that profile correspondence was established.
WHY surfaces must distinguish observed/explained factors from generic product copy.
required_retest: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: card with no decision_reason/match_reason cannot show a fabricated positive explanation.
PROVEN_AUTOMATED: absence of explanation remains unknown/unavailable while genuine explanation evidence is preserved.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE: a deliberately explanation-less opportunity does not tell the customer it matches their profile.
hard_boundary: Golden Path owns acceptance/regression only; explanation generation/presentation repair remains with its specialist owner.
